description: Renderer vectors that Increment 3b must satisfy (docs/email-marketing/EMAIL_CONTENT_V1_CONTRACT.md section 7). Every template is valid email-content.v1 for an organization with active custom fields 'plan' (select), 'score' and 'limit' (number), 'vip' (boolean) and 'birthday' (date). 'values' are the server-resolved strings (section 7.1 step 0) or null. Some vectors deliberately use values normal storage cannot produce (control characters in contact names, long or multi-line text in a select field): they are defense-in-depth inputs the renderer must still handle exactly. 'expected' lists the rendered subject (plain text, before provider RFC 2047 encoding), preheader_html (escaped HTML text, or null when omitted) and the rendered blocks in order (omitted blocks are absent): html is the escaped inner HTML of text blocks, *_attr are escaped double-quoted attribute values. 'error' (with 'location' where applicable) means the render fails for that contact.

cases.name: template text is HTML-escaped in every text context
alt text with quotes cannot break out of the attribute
substituted markup is escaped, never interpreted
substituted value is not re-expanded as a merge tag
paragraph: newlines from template and from values become line breaks
single-line fields: value newlines become one space; CR and forbidden characters are removed
subject and preheader: encoded-word markers from values are neutralized
subject: an encoded-word marker formed across a template/value boundary is neutralized
missing values use the fallback; archived custom fields behave as missing
empty subject after substitution fails the render for that contact
empty preheader, heading, button and paragraph after substitution are omitted
no heading, paragraph, button or image left after omissions fails the render
number custom field renders its PostgreSQL text form (no reformatting)
boolean and date custom fields render as true/false and YYYY-MM-DD
blank value is absent: the fallback is used
value that is empty after normalization is absent: the fallback is used
absent value with an empty fallback renders nothing
TAB becomes a space and a lone CR is a line break
subject longer than 400 code points after substitution fails the render
paragraph longer than 20000 code points after substitution fails the render
Unicode line separators U+0085, U+2028 and U+2029 are line breaks, not deletions
preheader longer than 500 code points after substitution fails the render
heading longer than 1000 code points after substitution fails the render
button text longer than 200 code points after substitution fails the render
fields exactly at their limits render
evaluation order: an empty subject is reported before a too-long block
evaluation order: the subject is checked before the blocks
final header safety: a contact value with a header-only variation selector makes the subject fail closed
final header safety: a custom value with a header-only variation selector makes the preheader fail closed
final header safety: the same variation selector from a merge value is allowed in body text
preheader at exactly its limit (500 code points) renders
heading at exactly its limit (1000 code points, 2000 UTF-16 units) renders
button text at exactly its limit (200 code points) renders
paragraph at exactly its limit (20000 code points) renders
paragraph one over its limit (20001 code points) fails the render
